## Sky Chart contract

### Source ownership
- [ ] One public renderer
- [ ] One interaction/filter controller
- [ ] Legacy public wheel owners retired

### Browser verification
- [ ] No deprecated first paint
- [ ] Comparison wheel renders
- [ ] Canonical glyphs only
- [ ] Predictable panel geometry
- [ ] Hover/dim/isolate filters relationship rows
- [ ] Selected Relationship shows the semantically matched dual cards and progressive reveal
- [ ] Desktop
- [ ] iPhone

Do not merge until every browser verification item is observed on the exact commit-pinned build.
